definitions.gloss: one after another; in succession; successively
definitions.explanation: Events or actions occurring in rapid sequence, one following closely after another. Often implies an unexpected or noteworthy series of occurrences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{相次|あいつ}いで⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{相次|あいつ}いで⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New shops are opening one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{相次|あいつ}いで⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こし→起こす：01234_okosu⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧になった。
examples.english: Major companies caused scandals one after another, becoming a social problem.

notes:
USAGE:
{相次|あいつ}いで is the te-form of the verb ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧, functioning as an adverb. It is commonly used in news reports and formal writing to describe a series of events happening in quick succession. The plain verb form ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧ is also used as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相次|あいつ}いで⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (to occur in succession)
- {相次|あいつ}いで⟦{報告|ほうこく}される→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧ (to be reported one after another)
- ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (a series of incidents)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: one after another (more casual)
- ⟦{続々|ぞくぞく}→続々：00436_zokuzoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: one after another, in droves
- ⟦{立|た}て{続|つづ}け→立て続け：13765_tatetsuzuke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in rapid succession
